PCL.ArcAdded: Campaign Ledger: added {name} and made it the current arc. Rename it on the Sessions tab.
PCL.ArchiveAsk: Copy the chat log ({count}) into the ledger with {name} and clear it from chat? The archive opens from the speech bubbles on the Sessions tab.
PCL.ArchiveBusy: Campaign Ledger: the chat is already being archived.
PCL.ArchiveChatTip: Copy the chat log into the ledger with {name}, and clear it
PCL.ArchiveFailed: Campaign Ledger: the chat wasn't archived ({error}). Nothing was deleted.
PCL.ArchiveNotActiveGM: Campaign Ledger: only the active GM ({name}) can archive the chat.
PCL.ArchivePublicListFailed: Campaign Ledger: the players' copy of the archive couldn't be listed; it will be put back the next time the GM loads the world.
PCL.ArchiveReadBackFailed: the saved archive didn't read back whole
PCL.ArchiveSaveFailed: the archive file couldn't be saved
PCL.ArchivedManyCleared: Campaign Ledger: {n} chat messages archived {where} and cleared from chat.
PCL.ArchivedNotCleared: Campaign Ledger: {n} chat messages archived ({where}), but {left} couldn't be cleared from chat. They are in the archive; delete them by hand rather than archiving again.
PCL.ArchivedOneCleared: Campaign Ledger: 1 chat message archived {where} and cleared from chat.
PCL.ChatClosed: The GM hasn't opened the archived chat to players.
PCL.CorrectElsewhere: Campaign Ledger: {why}. Correct the entry there.
PCL.DeleteAsk: Delete {name} and everything recorded in it? This can't be undone from the ledger (its file stays on disk, and an export can bring it back with Import).
PCL.DeleteChatStays: Its archived chat stays on the server. The archive window lists it under Deleted sessions unless you take it off.
PCL.DeleteChatToo: Take its archived chat off the list too
PCL.DiceNote: Every d20 counts, including the first roll of a reroll. Fortune and misfortune rolls (roll twice, keep one) are left out because they skew the curve. The dashed line is what a fair die would average for this many rolls. Luck is the average minus 10.5.
PCL.EncNote: Click an encounter for the breakdown.
PCL.EncNoteGM: Click an encounter for the breakdown. Enemy rows are shown to the GM only.
PCL.EndArchiveBox: Archive the chat log with this session and clear it ({count})
PCL.EndAsk: End {name}? The next roll starts a new session.
PCL.EndAskRecap: End {name}? The next roll starts a new session, and the recap goes to everyone.
PCL.ExportChatButton: Export this session's chat as Markdown
PCL.ExportChatGM: GM copy: everything, whispers and DCs included
PCL.ExportChatPlayers: Players' copy: what the table saw
PCL.ExportMissingMany: Campaign Ledger: {n} archive files are missing, so the export is only part of the chat.
PCL.ExportMissingOne: Campaign Ledger: 1 archive file is missing, so the export is only part of the chat.
PCL.ExportNoChat: Campaign Ledger: there's no archived chat for that session.
PCL.ExportNoPlayersChat: Campaign Ledger: there's no players' archived chat for that session.
PCL.HistLabel: How often {name} rolled each number on the d20
PCL.ImportNotExport: that isn't a Campaign Ledger export
PCL.ImportSkipped: Skipped {n} with an id that can't be a file name.
PCL.ImportText: Pick a file made by "Export everything". Sessions and arcs it holds are added; ones already in the ledger get any events they're missing. Nothing is deleted.
PCL.ImportTip: Restore sessions and arcs from an export. Nothing already here is removed.
PCL.ImportedMany: Campaign Ledger: imported {n} new sessions, merged {merged}.
PCL.ImportedOne: Campaign Ledger: imported 1 new session, merged {merged}.
PCL.LedgerClosed: The GM hasn't opened the Campaign Ledger to players.
PCL.ListFolderFailed: Campaign Ledger: couldn't list the ledger folder.
PCL.LogHealedHandBy: {a} is healed for {amount} (applied by hand), credited to {by}
PCL.LogTakenHandBy: {a} takes {amount} damage (applied by hand), credited to {by}
PCL.MdMissingMany: {n} archive files couldn't be read; this is part of the chat.
PCL.MdMissingOne: 1 archive file couldn't be read; this is part of the chat.
PCL.Name: Name
PCL.NoArcs: No arcs yet. Add one with the Arc button above.
PCL.NoChat: No chat has been archived yet.
PCL.NoChatGM: No chat has been archived yet. End a session with "Archive the chat" ticked, or use Archive chat in the ledger.
PCL.NoEncounters: No encounters recorded for this selection yet.
PCL.NoRolls: No d20 rolls for this selection yet.
PCL.NoSession: No session running. One starts by itself on the first roll.
PCL.NothingInSession: Campaign Ledger: nothing was recorded in that session.
PCL.NothingRecorded: Campaign Ledger: nothing recorded in that session yet.
PCL.NothingToResume: Campaign Ledger: there is no ended session to resume.
PCL.NothingYet: Nothing recorded for this selection yet.
PCL.NoticeEndingElsewhere: Campaign Ledger: ending {name} in your other tab, which is recording.
PCL.NoticeExpired: Campaign Ledger: {name} was still running from {date}; it has been ended.
PCL.NoticeExpiredNext: Campaign Ledger: {name} was still running from {date}; it has been ended and a new session starts now.
PCL.NoticeRecording: Campaign Ledger: recording {name}. Rename or end it from the ledger.
PCL.OtherTabRecording: another tab of yours is recording
PCL.PartyNote: Damage and healing are what was applied from a chat card, after resistances; hover for the amount rolled. Damage taken is what came off HP, with any temporary HP that went with it. Click a column to sort.
PCL.PostRecapOf: Post a recap of {name} to chat
PCL.ReadFailedOld: Campaign Ledger: couldn't read the file of an earlier session ({error}). The ledger leaves it out.
PCL.ReadFailedRunning: Campaign Ledger: couldn't read the session file ({error}). Nothing is recorded until it can be read, so the file isn't overwritten.
PCL.RecapForced: Most saves failed against them: {name} ({n} of {of})
PCL.RenameElsewhere: Campaign Ledger: {why}. Rename the encounter there.
PCL.RenameEncounterText: A name for this encounter (players see it). Leave it empty to go back to the scene name.
PCL.ResetChat: Archived chat isn't in the export: it stays on the server, and the archive window lists it under Deleted sessions.
PCL.ResetDone: Campaign Ledger: reset. The export is in your downloads.
PCL.ResetText: This clears every session, arc and encounter from the ledger. A full export downloads first; Import brings it back.
PCL.ResumeTip: Reopen the last ended session and keep recording into it
PCL.SaveFailed: Campaign Ledger: couldn't save the session file. Events are kept in memory; it will try again after the next roll. Check the server's Data/worlds folder.
PCL.SaveNumbersOf: Save the numbers of {name} as Markdown
PCL.SaveRecovered: Campaign Ledger: the session file saved.
PCL.SettingArchiveOfferHint: End session offers to copy the chat log into the ledger with the session and clear it (ticked by default). Archived chat opens from the Sessions tab. The GM's copy includes whispers; like GM journals, it's out of the players' view but not out of reach of a player who digs in the browser console.
PCL.SettingArchiveOfferName: Offer to archive the chat at End session
PCL.SettingArchivePlayersHint: When players can open the ledger, they can also read archived chat: their copy holds only messages everyone saw, without whispers, blind rolls or what PF2e shows the GM alone (DCs, modifiers, roll formulas).
PCL.SettingArchivePlayersName: Players can read the archived chat
PCL.SettingNeedPlayerHint: Rolls the GM makes alone (prep between sessions) don't start a new session. New session in the ledger starts one at any time.
PCL.SettingNeedPlayerName: Start a session only when a player is logged in
PCL.SettingPlayerViewHint: Players get a read-only view of party statistics. Enemy breakdowns stay GM-only.
PCL.SettingRecapHint: When a session ends, post a short recap card to chat: biggest hit, crits, kills, who went down and who brought them back.
PCL.SettingRecordingHint: Record rolls, damage, healing and combat to the ledger. Turn off for test rolls or one-shots.
PCL.SettingSessionGapHint: A session nobody ended is ended by itself when the next roll comes this many hours after its last one, and a new session starts. 0 turns this off.
PCL.SettingStartNoticeHint: When a session starts recording (on the first roll, or with New session), whisper the GM a note in chat.
PCL.Speaker: Speaker
PCL.TipDamage: Damage dealt, after resistances and not counting overkill. Hover a number for the amount rolled.
PCL.TipEncForced: Saves forced on the other side: failed / rolled
PCL.TipEncSkills: Skill checks that succeeded / against a DC
PCL.TipFriendlyFire: Damage dealt to their own side, not counted in Damage
PCL.TipHealing: Healing applied to HP. Hover a number for the amount rolled.
PCL.TipHitRate: Of attacks rolled against a target
PCL.TipRerolls: Rerolls that improved the result / all rerolls
PCL.TipRevived: Allies brought back up from 0 HP
PCL.TipSavesForced: Saves your spells and abilities forced on the other side: failed / rolled
PCL.TipSkills: Skill checks that succeeded / skill checks against a DC. Initiative isn't counted.
PCL.TipTaken: Damage taken: what came off HP, with the temporary HP that went with the same hit
PCL.Title: Campaign Ledger
PCL.WhisperEnded: It was still running from {date}, so it has been ended as of its last event. If that evening isn't over yet, use "Resume last session" in the ledger.
PCL.WhisperEndedNext: It was still running from {date}, so it has been ended as of its last event and a new session starts with this one. If that evening isn't over yet, use "Resume last session" in the ledger.
PCL.WhisperRecording: Rolls, damage and combat from now on go into this session. Rename it, or end it, from the ledger.
